job.title: Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM - Jobbird.com

tailoring.headline: Senior Berater SAP CX & Commerce Cloud – Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and data pipelines linking PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven techno-functional consultant: requirement analysis, user stories, functional specs and stakeholder coordination. Hands-on CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, production support and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Jobster’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge SAP CX solutions to leading enterprises. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, API design and complex PIM/ERP integrations that align perfectly with this senior consulting role.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Designed and delivered OCC REST services and headless APIs on SAP Commerce Cloud, enabling seamless storefront and third-party consumption.

bullets.label: Integration Design
bullets.text: Built robust PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks for global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted as the bridge between business and IT, gathering requirements, writing user stories, functional specs and guiding stakeholders through solution design.

bullets.label: Production & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, managed Docker/Kubernetes environments and provided 24/7 production support, ensuring high availability.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026 and available to start 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your SAP CX projects.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
cover_de.hook: Die Innovationskraft von Jobster im Bereich SAP CX begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Know-how in Java, Spring, API-Entwicklung und komplexen PIM/ERP-Integrationen mit, das exakt zu dieser Senior-Berater-Position passt.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwickelte OCC-REST-Services und Headless-APIs auf SAP Commerce Cloud, um nahtlose Storefront- und Drittanbieter-Anbindungen zu ermöglichen.

bullets.label: Integrationsdesign
bullets.text: Erstellte robuste PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) und löste ERP/MDM-Integrationsengpässe für globale E-Commerce-Kanäle.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Agierte als Bindeglied zwischen Business und IT, erfasste Anforderungen, schrieb User Stories, funktionale Spezifikationen und begleitete Stakeholder durch das Lösungsdesign.

bullets.label: Production & CI/CD
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 durch, managte Docker/Kubernetes-Umgebungen und leistete 24/7-Produktionssupport für hohe Verfügbarkeit.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Gerne erläutere ich in einem Gespräch, welchen Mehrwert ich für Ihre SAP-CX-Projekte schaffen kann.

tailoring.why_company: Jobster stands out for its focus on accelerating SAP CX transformations through innovative, customer-centric architectures. I am drawn to your collaborative culture and the opportunity to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help clients modernize their field-service and customer-management landscapes, delivering measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration expertise to drive successful SAP CX projects at Jobster, contributing to innovative customer-experience solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience. I’m interested in the Senior Berater SAP CX role at Jobster and would love to discuss how I can contribute. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Berater SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Berater SAP CX FSM / CS / CM position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my integration and consulting expertise to Jobster.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
